ladder.label: UNCONFIRMED TURN
ladder.why: A daily bottoming setup is forming (swing low in, momentum turned up) — but the higher timeframes haven't confirmed it: the bigger picture is still bearish (weekly momentum just crossed down; last cycle left-translated (topped early)). This is an UNCONFIRMED TURN, not a confirmed buy. Weekly confirmation lags price, so this exact reading covers BOTH bounces that fail AND the first leg of a genuine new cycle — you can't tell which in real time, so treat it as a risk/size signal, not a direction call. Measured: weekly-unconfirmed bottoming setups held the low ~49% of the time vs ~68% once the weekly turns up. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 209.0. Not an investment buy yet. What would upgrade it: weekly momentum turning up, a reclaim of the investor-cycle low, or the first daily cycle right-translating — add on confirmation, not ahead of it.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum just crossed down; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum just crossed down; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 12 · daily cycle day 56).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): unconfirmed turn. Bigger picture (counter-trend): bearish.

entry.text: An unconfirmed turn: a daily low is forming while the bigger picture is still bearish. Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 209.0. Not an investment buy until the weekly confirms; most of these fail, a minority start a new cycle.
entry.text_zh: 未确认转向：日线低点正在形成，但大局仍偏空。仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、止损设于 209.0 下方。在周线确认前并非投资性买入；多数最终失败，少数则开启新周期。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 56 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_phase: overdue — past the typical window, so a low could form any day
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 56 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.daily_phase_zh: 逾期——已超过典型窗口，低点随时可能形成
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 12 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: mid — the bigger up-leg is maturing
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 12 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.why_zh: 正在形成日线筑底形态（摆动低点已现、动量转向上行）——但更高周期尚未确认：大局仍偏空（周线动量刚刚向下交叉；上一周期左移（见顶偏早））。这是「未确认转向」，并非已确认的买入。周线确认滞后于价格，因此同样的读数既涵盖最终失败的反弹，也涵盖真正新周期的第一段——实时无法判定属于哪一种，故应将其视为风险/仓位信号，而非方向判断。实测：周线未确认的筑底形态约 49% 守住低点，周线转向后升至约 68%。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、止损设于 209.0 下方。暂非投资性买入。何种情形会升级：周线动量转为向上、收复投资者周期低点、或首个日线周期呈右移结构——在确认之后加仓，而非提前。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — 周线动量刚刚向下交叉；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 12 周 · 日线周期第 56 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：未确认转向。大局（逆势）：看空。
points_zh: 大局为看空（对日线多头而言属逆势）
宏观：美国净流动性收缩——对概率属需谨慎

ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ UNCONFIRMED TURN signal triggered 4 trading days ago (~2026-06-12), switching from NEARING A HIGH. Signal strength: mild (score -35/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 未确认转向信号于 4 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-12），自接近高点切换而来。 信号强度：温和（评分 -35/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱未确认转向（+30）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_line_zh: 日线 ✗ · 3日 ✓ · 周线 ✓ · 月线 ✗
ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。

headline.en: Rate risk runs through its market / growth beta, not a distinct duration leg.
headline.zh: 其利率风险通过市场／成长beta体现，并无独立的久期暴露。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta +0.06 ± 0.19 — low / noisy precision. Sector anchor (XLI) reads duration-neutral (+0.01). Inflation-neutral.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta +0.06 ± 0.19——精度低／噪声。 板块锚（XLI）为久期中性（+0.01）。 通胀中性。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。

detail.en: Mid-range composite and accumulation — no contrarian extension or washout edge here.
detail.zh: 综合分与吸筹均处中位 — 无逆向高位或超卖的边际。

caveat.en: Contrarian read — the INVERSE of the indicator's usual framing. Validated (display-only) that a high composite flags lower forward-63d returns (decile Spearman −0.88) and that rising 'whale accumulation' precedes under-performance (monthly IC t≈−3.9). Large-cap survivor sample; a tilt, not a trade.
caveat.zh: 逆向解读 — 与该指标常规用法相反。经验证（仅供展示）：高综合分预示未来63日回报更低（分位单调 Spearman −0.88），且“鲸鱼吸筹”上升反而领先跑输（月度 IC t≈−3.9）。样本为大盘幸存股；是倾斜而非交易信号。
